01_people.speaker: neha
01_people.text: Every month, millions of people in India repay a loan. For a phone, a bike, a small shop.

02_same.speaker: neha
02_same.text: And every month, lenders remind them the same way. Same message. Same time. To everyone.

03_cost.speaker: neha
03_cost.text: Most of those messages are ignored. Some annoy people. And every single one costs money.

04_meet.speaker: neha
04_meet.text: Meet Kairos. An AI that runs loan collections, one person at a time.

05_looks.speaker: neha
05_looks.text: Every morning, Kairos looks at each borrower. How late they are, how they replied before, and when they usually read their messages.

06_decides.speaker: neha
06_decides.text: Then it decides. Contact them today, or wait.

07_channel.speaker: neha
07_channel.text: It picks the channel. SMS, WhatsApp, a voice call in their language, or a human. And the best time of day.

08_aladdin.speaker: neha
08_aladdin.text: Before anything is sent, Aladdin, our safety supervisor, checks it against the lender's rules. Twice.

09_rules.speaker: neha
09_rules.text: No messages at night. Never more than allowed. And if someone says stop, everything stops. On every channel.

10_reply.speaker: neha
10_reply.text: When a borrower writes back on WhatsApp, Kairos answers in seconds, in Hindi or in English.

12_verify.speaker: neha
12_verify.text: It confirms who they are before sharing any loan details. And if someone sends a fake payment screenshot, it checks with the bank, and catches it.

13_learns.speaker: neha
13_learns.text: Every reply, and every payment, teaches Kairos something new. So it gets better, every single day.

14_operator.speaker: neha
14_operator.text: And the collections team? They watch the money come in, and approve the few decisions that need a human.

15_proof.speaker: neha
15_proof.text: In our tests, Kairos recovered about twice as much money for every rupee spent, compared to a fixed schedule.

16_safe.speaker: neha
16_safe.text: With zero rule breaches. And every safety test passed.

17_end.speaker: neha
17_end.text: Kairos. The right message, at the right time. Or none at all.

t1_record.speaker: neha
t1_record.text: Under the hood, every borrower lives in one record. Loans, payments, replies, consent.

t2_model.speaker: neha
t2_model.text: A learning model scores every channel and every hour for them, using what worked for similar borrowers in their region, and for them personally.

t3_reserve.speaker: neha
t3_reserve.text: Before a message is queued, Aladdin reserves the budget and the contact limit. At the moment of sending, it checks the rules again.

t4_webhooks.speaker: neha
t4_webhooks.text: Messages go out through each channel's API. Delivery, read and reply receipts come back as webhooks. Duplicates are ignored.

t5_intent.speaker: neha
t5_intent.text: Replies are understood by rules first, then a small model, then Sarvam's decision model. If it's still unsure, a human decides.

t6_loop.speaker: neha
t6_loop.text: Every outcome is written back, and the model updates. Same data in, same decision out. Every step, on the record.

02s_same.speaker: neha
02s_same.text: Every month, lenders remind borrowers the same way. Same message. Same time. To everyone.
